result:
Clean type-check and all 617 existing tests pass. The implementation is complete:

- `src/config/constants.ts`: `MAX_SUB_ISSUE_DEPTH = 3`.
- `src/lib/issue-hierarchy.ts`: new `IssueHierarchyError`.
- `src/lib/errors.ts`: maps it to `conflict`, recognized by `isDomainError`.
- `src/types/issue.ts`: `IssueRollup`.
- `src/schemas/issue.ts`: `setIssueParentSchema`/`SetIssueParentInput`.
- `src/types/event.ts`, `src/types/notification.ts`, `src/schemas/notification.ts`, `src/server/db/schema/notifications.ts`, the preferences form labels: new `issue.sub_issues_completed` event and `sub_issues_completed` notification kind, wired through `notification-service.ts`'s existing fan-out.
- `src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`: `listDirectSubIssues`, `listLiveDescendants`, `loadSubtreeShape`, `findIssueLevel`, `setIssueParent`.
- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts`: `createIssue` now validates a parent given at creation (same project, live, depth); new `setIssueParent` (cycle/depth guards, `issue.updated` with `changedFields: ["parentId"]`); new `listSubIssues`, `getIssueRollup`; `changeIssueStatus` and `archiveIssue` now fire the once-per-closing `sub_issues_completed` notification via a shared `notifyParentIfFullyClosed` helper; `archiveIssue` cascades to every live descendant (archiving the whole subtree before running completion checks, so an external parent's rollup is never read mid-cascade).
